prompts: Create a production pixel-art character sprite sheet, 4 columns x 4 rows exactly, 16 evenly spaced equal square cells, transparent background. Reference image is the strict character/style model: replicate its TOP LEFT frog's broad yellow pear torso, huge peach cream round belly, green iris black eyes, thin mouth, olive bare hands/feet, stocky bent short legs, dark brown stepped outlines and flat clustered yellow shading. No new design, no clothes, no text, no panels or grid lines, no glow. Each sprite isolated within its cell with clear margin, fully visible. Same right-facing three-quarter orientation and consistent character size across cells; no tails. Row1 four JUMP poses: deep squat anticipation / strong takeoff with arms low legs extending / rising with knees tucked / apex open arms and bent knees. Row2: descending with arms up legs down / cushioned landing squat with hands forward / recovered half-standing after landing / low forward dash lean with arms trailing. Row3 HIT reactions: light recoil chest / heavy belly impact bending forward / launched backwards with limbs spread / falling curled on side. Row4: lying defeated on side with round belly intact / pushing up from floor on one hand and knee / halfway rising bent knees / guard broken startled open arms stagger. These are distinct authored poses, not rotated copies of idle. Keep the same head, belly and limb proportions and palette as reference top left. Organize exactly left-to-right, top-to-bottom in the stated order, 16 full-body pixel sprites.

Create a production pixel-art character sprite sheet 4 columns x 2 rows exactly, 8 equal square cells on transparent background, no borders, no letters, no backdrop. Image1 is strict pixel model: use TOP LEFT frog's identical broad stocky pear body, huge peach cream belly, yellow flat clustered shading, green ring black eyes, olive hands/feet, brown stepped outlines. Image2 is POSE reference ONLY for first two cells; do not copy its photographic style. Keep art identical to image1, character scale consistent as standing height reference. Eight distinct poses left to right: Row1 cell1 reclining sideways on one elbow, one hand on top of head, upper leg crossed and lifted toward left, belly relaxed, deadpan eyes toward viewer EXACTLY like pose photo; cell2 same reclining pose legs slightly uncrossing ready to get up; cell3 sitting up with palm supporting floor and knees drawing in; cell4 squat getting up, one hand wiping head. Row2 cell1 VICTORY standing smug belly-forward with both hands on hips, subtle smile; cell2 VICTORY one hand gives peace sign near head, other on belly, cheerful eyes toward viewer; cell3 DEFEAT sitting on ground slumped with elbows on knees, downcast eyes, full round belly; cell4 DEFEAT side slumped sitting with one hand covering face, legs spread resting. Preserve stocky body and oversized belly in every pose, same recognizable character and pixel sizes as top left reference. No wings, no halo, no props. All eight sprites fully contained in exact 4x2 grid, centered foot/floor contact near bottom of each square cell.
